decks.notes: This Rakdos aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage quickly. It also includes burn spells like Titan's Strength and Reckless Rage to control the board and finish off opponents. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and flexibility in deck construction. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game to secure a swift victory.

This aggressive Jund deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven to control the board and deal damage directly to the opponent. With the help of the Companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional mana consistency, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature sacrifice synergies and removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It also includes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for card advantage and Scavenger's Talent to disrupt opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on playing creatures quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with aggro pressure. The key strategy involves using cards like Collected Company and Relic of Legends to quickly get creatures on the battlefield, while also utilizing mana accelerants like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to speed up the process. Cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Gwenna, Eyes of Gaea provide additional support for the creature-based strategy, while cards like Honest Rutstein and Rona, Herald of Invasion help maintain tempo and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and win through creature damage.

This UW Control deck focuses on a high level of control and disruption to counter and remove opponent's threats while setting up your win condition. It utilizes cards like Supreme Verdict, Dovin's Veto, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Settle the Wreckage to control the board, while also using card draw and selection spells like Omen of the Sea and Memory Deluge to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy.

The main concept of this aggro Arclight Phoenix deck is to quickly and efficiently cast spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while also utilizing cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Treasure Cruise helps to refill the hand with more spells, and Proft's Eidetic Memory can provide additional value. The deck aims to control the board with cheap removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse, while also having some counter magic with Spell Pierce to protect key spells.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with green creatures and utilize devotion mechanics to power up key cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. By ramping quickly with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck can play big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Storm the Festival allows for digging for important cards, while Leyline of the Guildpact helps ensure board presence. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional support and protection for the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board using sacrifice effects and low-cost creatures. By utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to generate incremental advantage while chipping away at the opponent's life total. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and utility. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast, efficient creatures and powerful sacrifice synergies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict to control the board. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The deck also has various land options to ensure mana stability and consistency. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and out-valuing the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Voldaren Thrillseeker, backed up by removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt the opponent?s strategy and maintain pressure. The mana base includes lands like Blood Crypt and Blackcleave Cliffs to ensure consistent color access. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's plans, and close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent through various means such as removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while utilizing cards like Waste Not to generate advantage. It also includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred to apply pressure and close out the game. The deck uses a combination of removal, hand disruption, and win conditions to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a one-on-one duel.

The focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up its own resources and advantage. It utilizes a variety of control tools like Dovin's Veto, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Supreme Verdict to keep the opponent in check. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value and flexibility in the deck's strategy, ensuring that the control player can outlast and outmaneuver their opponent.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand and removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds additional value by recurring threats or disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to apply early pressure and close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures quickly to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Bishop of Wings and Righteous Valkyrie, it aims to create a strong board presence and chip away at the opponent's life total. Collected Company provides additional creature synergy and allows for explosive turns. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with a mix of dual lands and mana dorks to ramp into powerful threats. The key strategy is to establish a fast clock and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and overwhelm your opponent with fast and aggressive plays. Utilizing cards like Lightning Axe, Treasure Cruise, and Opt to draw and discard cards efficiently while controlling the board with removal spells like Fiery Impulse. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder also helps in filling the graveyard and enabling the Phoenix's revival. The deck aims to be fast, proactive, and relentless in its attack strategy.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures to apply pressure on the opponent, while also utilizing cards like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie to gain an advantage through lifegain and buffs. The deck includes cards like Collected Company to help you find the right creatures at the right time, ensuring a consistent and aggressive strategy. By curving out with efficient creatures and utilizing cards like Kayla's Reconstruction for extra value, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures and push for a fast victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy and prevent them from executing their game plan effectively. It includes counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain card advantage and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of the companion Yorion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in gameplay. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and dominate the game through efficient resource management and strategic decision-making.
